title: Returned Payments on Rural Home Loans: Reversal and Reopened Months
content:
Payment operations standard for a remittance on a Rural Home Loans loan that the member's bank returns unpaid.

## Clauses in force

1. A returned payment is reversed entry by entry — interest, principal and escrow deposit — each return entry carrying the original entry's amount and effective date and pointing to it, which reopens the monthly payment it had paid.
2. A payment may be reversed only once.
3. If the reopened month is now past its grace period, its late charge is assessed under the late charge rule of the product.

## Retired clause

**Retired clause — no longer in force; superseded by the current basis.** "One returned payment fee of the product's returned payment fee is assessed per returned remittance (booked from the principal return entry) unless the return reason is unauthorized."

## Reading clause 1

| Original entry | Return entry booked | Amount and date on the return entry | Points to |
|---|---|---|---|
| Interest payment | interest payment return | the original amount and effective date | the original interest payment |
| Principal payment | principal payment return | the original amount and effective date | the original principal payment |
| Escrow deposit | escrow deposit return | the original amount and effective date | the original deposit |

Because the reversed interest and principal no longer count toward the bill they paid, that monthly payment is open again.

## Duplicate check (clause 2)

The payment history is read for an interest or principal payment return already pointing to the same payment; a payment already reversed is not reversed again.

superseded_clauses: One returned payment fee of returned_payment_fee_usd is assessed per returned remittance (booked from the principal return row) unless the return reason is unauthorized.
